description:
Discount Market Rate apartment! Please see details below*

£3,000 Prezee Voucher included! * £2,000 Ikea voucher for unfurnished apartments!

Welcome to Enclave Birmingham City, a striking new pet-friendly community in Birmingham’s vibrant Southside district. Designed with modern living in mind, this landmark development combines contemporary architecture with first-class facilities, creating a stylish and connected lifestyle in the heart of the city.

The Apartments

Each apartment has been thoughtfully crafted to blend comfort, functionality, and design flair. Smart home technology, sleek finishes, and open-plan layouts come together to create bright, modern spaces ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. Expect SMEG fittings throughout, generous storage, and a contemporary aesthetic that feels effortlessly at home in one of Birmingham’s most dynamic neighbourhoods.

Exclusive Amenities

Residents enjoy access to a wealth of premium on-site amenities:

Flexible lease terms with no deposit required

24/7 on-site resident team and dedicated maintenance support

Co-working spaces, podcast studios, and private meeting rooms

Family and pet-friendly facilities, including a soft play area and pet wash

With two buildings open already and the third launching in Spring 2026, even more luxury amenities are on the way — from a state-of-the-art gym, spa, cinema, and games room to beautifully landscaped rooftop gardens, a bar lounge, and music room. Every detail is curated to support a seamless, social, and sophisticated lifestyle.

The Location

Perfectly positioned on Lower Essex Street, this development sits moments from Birmingham New Street Station and the Bullring, placing you within easy reach of the city’s best shopping, dining, and entertainment. Southside’s eclectic mix of cafés, theatres, and cultural hotspots means there’s always something new to discover right on your doorstep

*Prezee Vouchers are gift cards that can be used on all sorts of different brands, allowing you to buy everything from luxury goods, meals out or even holidays. Speak to our team to find out more.
*Available for student let
* Imagery is indicative

*Discount Market Rate apartment conditions apply: 
Single renters must earn below £30,000 per year and couples must earn below £45,000 per year.
Viewing Tour disclaimer: This advertisement relates to a specific unit at the stated rent. Where multiple units are available within the same development, you may be shown other apartments during your viewing. Each unit is marketed at its own advertised rent, which will be clearly confirmed to you before any offer is submitted. We do not accept offers above the advertised rent for any property. The rent agreed will always be the advertised rent for the selected unit, in accordance with the Renters’ Rights Act.
